entities.summary: Sarah Margru Kinson was a West African educator. As Margru or Mar'gru, she was one of the four children on La Amistad. The ship's passengers were the subject of a case in the American Supreme Court and a 1997 film. As Sarah Kinson, she was educated at Oberlin College and returned to West Africa to be a missionary teacher. She is considered the first woman born in Africa to be educated in an American college.
